posts.post:
people who keep their clothes strictly color-coded in their closet aren't organized. 

they're just bored.
the weird guilt of wearing something brand new when you're just going to the grocery store.

hiding your favorite pieces in the back of the closet so they don't get ruined. 

we all have that one item we're too scared to wear.
layering three different textures without looking like a laundry pile is the only talent i respect.
